description: This Java class 'LogViewer' provides a GUI component for browsing and opening log files related to the rusEfi project. It includes functionality to scan a default directory for log files, display them in a list, and load selected logs into the engine state for visualization.

classes.name: LogViewer
classes.description: A Swing JPanel component that provides a user interface for browsing, selecting, and loading log files for the rusEfi engine.

methods.name: LogViewer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the log viewer panel, setting up UI components, and scanning the default log directory.

methods.name: refreshCountPanel
methods.description: Updates the display showing the total number of digital charts loaded.

methods.name: openFolder
methods.description: Opens a specified folder, filters log files, and automatically opens the most recent log that isn't the current log.

methods.name: getFileDesc
methods.description: Creates a FileItem description object for a given File.

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Loads a selected log file into the engine state and updates the UI accordingly.
